## About
Hall-Mead Transmission is an automatic transmission repair shop in Madison, Tennessee. We're affiliated with the Automatic Transmission Rebuilders Association (ATRA) and follow its code of ethics.
We make our customers a simple promise: we won't remove a transmission from your vehicle to complete a repair unless it's absolutely necessary, and we'll diagnose the problem in an honest and expert manner.
Reviewers mention Gary by name, along with fair prices and the way we work folks into the schedule. We're rated 4.6 from 51 Google reviews, and we hope you'll come back to us whenever your transmission needs work.

## Services
- Automatic transmission repair: Repair by technicians who work on automatic transmissions every day.
- Diagnose transmission problems: An honest, expert look at what's actually wrong before any work starts.
- Transmission rebuild: Complete rebuilds, worked into our schedule as quickly as we can.
- Transmission service: Service and parts replacement when a full replacement isn't needed.
- Transmission and filter change: Fluid and filter work for cars and trucks, done promptly.

## FAQ
Q: Will you have to pull my transmission?
A: Only if it's absolutely necessary. That's a pledge we make to every customer.

Q: Do you work on trucks?
A: Yes. One reviewer brought us a work truck that was pulling a trailer through Nashville.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Thursday 8:00am to 5:00pm, and Friday 7:30am to 4:00pm. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
